title: Export PDF
description: Export your resume as a PDF document using your browser's print dialog.
startOverConfirmDesc: This will clear all your current CV data and start fresh. This action cannot be undone.

instructions.step2: In the browser print dialog, select "Save as PDF" as the destination.
instructions.step4: Set margins to "Default" or "None" for best results.
instructions.step5: Disable browser headers and footers for a cleaner document.
instructions.step6: Enable "Background graphics" if you want to preserve accent colors.
instructions.step7: Review the preview, then click Save.

errors.PRINT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Your browser does not support printing. Please try a different browser.
errors.CV_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: CV document was not found on this page. Please navigate to the Builder first.
errors.CV_NOT_READY: Your CV is not ready for export. Please fill in the required fields.
errors.PRINT_FAILED: An error occurred while opening the print dialog. Please try again.
